name: RMIT Equity Notebook Grant
summary: Up to $1,000 towards a laptop for new full-time RMIT students in financial hardship.
who: Australian or NZ citizen, permanent resident or permanent humanitarian visa holder.
Starting full-time in a certificate III or IV, diploma or undergraduate degree in Semester 1 2027.
Demonstrated financial hardship, such as a low-income Centrelink payment or Health Care Card.
how: Apply direct to RMIT online with supporting documents, or through VTAC.
catches: Not for postgraduate coursework or anyone who's had an RMIT laptop or laptop funds before.

evidence.quote: This grant provides up to $1,000 to purchase a notebook computer.
Applications for Semester 1 2027 close 2:00pm Tuesday 20 October 2026.
